_comment: Non-pip components: runtimes, detector/forensics code, datasets, fonts. 'basis': V = verified this project by reading the licence/metadata; A = reported by the research agents who fetched the source (not re-checked by me); R = recalled, UNVERIFIED. Re-verify R and A items before relying on them.

runtimes.name: onnxruntime
runtimes.note: CPU/XNNPACK, NNAPI, CoreML, QNN execution providers

runtimes.name: Qualcomm QNN/HTP libraries bundled in onnxruntime-qnn
runtimes.note: Qualcomm AI Stack License: non-exclusive, non-transferable, REVOCABLE; redistribution only in object code embedded in your app, not standalone; no reverse engineering; $100 liability cap; auto-terminates on breach; export controls. Treat the NPU path as an optional accelerator with an open-licence CPU/GPU fallback. Legal review required.

code.name: Ultralytics YOLO (v5/v8/11)
code.note: enterprise licence needed for closed commercial use

code.name: torchvision detection models (SSDLite, FCOS)
code.note: train from scratch: pretrained COCO/ImageNet weights carry their own data terms

code.name: Community Forensics (AI-image detector)
code.note: code and weights MIT; 21.8M params, needs distillation for mobile

code.name: UnivFD
code.note: needs CLIP ViT-L: too large for device

code.name: NPR, C2P-CLIP, CAT-Net, MVSS-Net, ManTra-Net
code.note: no licence file = all rights reserved

code.name: PP-OCRv3 detector + recogniser weights (PaddleOCR; app/assets/models/ocr_det.onnx, ocr_rec.onnx, ocr_charset.txt)
code.note: RECALLED, not verified here: PaddleOCR code and released models are Apache-2.0. Already shipped by the Flutter app and (as RapidOCR) by the old backend, so this adds no new exposure - but it IS an Apache-2.0 component on the reading path: if policy.json excludes Apache-2.0 it must be replaced (retrain the line recogniser from ml/training on synthetic + own captures). Also confirm with legal that the training-data terms of the published weights allow commercial use.

datasets.name: witvix/indian-truck-license-plates-sample
datasets.note: evaluation inspiration only; commercial use needs a licence from the owner

datasets.name: Open Images V7 (annotations CC-BY-4.0, images CC-BY-2.0)
datasets.note: commercial OK with attribution; Google says verify per image; keep per-image licence + author

datasets.name: COCO images
datasets.note: do not train a commercial model on them

datasets.name: Synthetic data generated by this repo

fonts.name: all families in synth/fonts (Google Fonts, SIL OFL 1.1; OFL.txt shipped per family)
fonts.note: used to render training images only; no font software ships in the model
